_why:
#29 — two silent demotions of a HARD finding, closed together because both are 'the detector fired on the wrong axis'. (a) `path.py:L2` parsed as a SYMBOL, so one stale pin scored FAIL written `:2` and PASS written `:L2`; six of seven spellings escaped entirely (probe `wsg7-carried-claims.probe.v1.md` §1 Reading A). (b) pins inside `## Version History` were scored live — the section holds prose ABOUT changes and the detectors read it as the changes themselves (§3). NOT 'text the assembler omits': that justification was retracted when it shipped and is false (`--vh-tail` defaults to a no-op; a table-shaped history is never trimmed). Each mutation carries its own `test` — ALL_CAUGHT without per-mutation keys is a wrong-catcher hole.

NOT MUTATED, deliberately and reported rather than faked: the over-correction on the L-branch (every `L…` tail read as a line). It is prevented REDUNDANTLY — both `_PATHISH`'s branch and `_LINE_TAIL` require a digit after the `L` — so no single find/replace expresses it: dropping the requirement from either one alone leaves the other gating and the mutation survives honestly, and dropping it from `_LINE_TAIL` in a way that DOES change behaviour crashes `int()` instead, which is a crash-kill and reads as a false clean kill. `test_a_symbol_whose_name_begins_with_L_is_still_a_symbol` is therefore a regression guard over a structural property, not a mutated guard. The demotion covers EVERY hard kind, not just pins: scoping it to pins was the first cut and the corpus refuted it (`gate-blindness-hardening.impl-plan.md` FAILED on two hard findings, both inside its history, both NARRATION of fixes already made). All six hard emit sites now route through scan()'s `hard()` router, so two mutations — the boundary never found, and the boundary covering everything — cover all six rather than needing one per site.

REVISED after the fresh-context review of `a8b9e4e` found this spec's boundary coverage insufficient (F5): three single-edit boundary mutations were green across the whole suite. The boundary's own rows now live in `precheck_version_history_boundary.json`, which mutates the delegation to `h_mad_version_history` rather than a private arithmetic. The L-RANGE row is retired here because the two tail branches merged into one pattern (`L?\d+…`, review F10) and that literal is mutated there — two names for one guard is worse than one.

mutations.name: the-line-predicate-rejects-the-L-spelling
mutations._mechanism: THE defect, and where it actually lived: `tail.isdigit()` said `L2` was not a line, so a stale pin fell through to the SYMBOL branch -- FAIL written `:2`, PASS written `:L2`. Restoring the old predicate restores exactly that.

mutations.name: the-finding-prints-the-normalized-tail
mutations._mechanism: Reading B reintroduced by the fix for Reading A: the operator cannot grep the printed token back to the document, nor paste it into --allow-historical.
mutations.find: f"`{rel}:{tail}` — `{rel}` changed since the document's provenance `{prov[:7]}`",
mutations.replace: f"`{rel}:{digits}` — `{rel}` changed since the document's provenance `{prov[:7]}`",

mutations.name: only-the-written-spelling-declares-a-pin
mutations._mechanism: A declaration typed `:1` against a document that says `:L1` is then ignored WITHOUT AN ERROR — the operator sees the pin still reported and concludes the flag is broken.

mutations.name: the-version-history-boundary-is-never-found
mutations._mechanism: Restores the pre-#29 behaviour: a document whose body carries no pin at all FAILs on a dated history entry that is correct as history and must not be edited. Re-anchored at the #29 review: the boundary is now a RANGE from `h_mad_version_history`, not a single start line.

mutations.name: the-version-history-demotion-covers-the-whole-document
mutations._mechanism: The over-correction, and the one that matters: 40 of this repo's 44 phase documents carry a Version History, so a boundary that leaks upward silences PINDRIFT corpus-wide while every verdict still prints.
mutations.find: return vh_bounds is not None and vh_bounds[0] <= lineno <= vh_bounds[1]

mutations.name: the-version-history-demotion-is-silent
mutations._mechanism: A suppression nobody can see is indistinguishable from a detector that never fired — the same bar `--allow-historical`'s demotion is held to. Anchored on the `hard()` router, so this one row covers all six hard kinds.
